GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 463.7 (12 Nov 47) GD
(SCAPIN - 1819/1)
APO 500
2 October 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Disposition of Petroleum Products, Ex-Japanese Army-Navy Stock.
1. Reference: Memorandum for the Japanese Government from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, file AG 463.7 (12 Nov 47)GD SCAPIN 1819, 12 November 1947, subject: Disposition of Petroleum Products Ex-Japanese Army-Navy Stock.
2. Effective immediately, the report required by paragraph 3a of the referenced memorandum covering the status of stocks, issues, and receipts of petroleum products, will be discontinued.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
